title: SQL JOINs
description: Every PostgreSQL join type, how matching and NULL padding work, cardinality pitfalls, and anti-join patterns.

root.label: JOINs
root.detail: Combine rows from two or more tables.

children.label: INNER JOIN
children.detail: Only rows that match on both sides.

children.label: Equi-join on key
children.detail: ON a.id = b.a_id; USING (col) merges the column.

children.label: Bridge tables
children.detail: Route through an intermediate table.

children.label: Non-equi joins
children.detail: Join on <, >, BETWEEN.

children.label: Outer joins
children.detail: Keep unmatched rows with NULL padding.

children.label: LEFT JOIN
children.detail: All left rows; NULLs where right is missing.

children.label: Chained LEFT JOINs
children.detail: An INNER join later can undo the LEFT.

children.label: RIGHT JOIN
children.detail: Mirror of LEFT; usually rewritten as LEFT.

children.label: FULL OUTER JOIN
children.detail: All rows from both sides.

children.label: ON vs WHERE filter
children.detail: WHERE on right column turns LEFT into INNER.

children.label: COALESCE padded NULLs
children.detail: Show 0 instead of NULL for missing totals.

children.label: SELF JOIN
children.detail: Same table, two aliases.

children.label: Manager hierarchy
children.detail: employee.reports_to = manager.id.

children.label: Pairs: a.id < b.id
children.detail: Avoid self-pairs and mirrored duplicates.

children.label: CROSS JOIN
children.detail: Cartesian product: |A| x |B| rows.

children.label: All combinations
children.detail: No ON clause.

children.label: Attach a scalar row
children.detail: Join a 1-row CTE to every row.

children.label: Anti & semi joins
children.detail: Rows with / without a match.

children.label: LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL
children.detail: Test the right side's key IS NULL.

children.label: NOT EXISTS
children.detail: Null-safe, usually same plan as anti-join.

children.label: NOT IN trap
children.detail: Any NULL in the list yields no rows.

children.label: Cardinality
children.detail: How many rows a join produces.

children.label: Fan-out
children.detail: 1-to-many joins multiply rows; SUM inflates.

children.label: Aggregate before join
children.detail: Pre-aggregate in a CTE to avoid double counting.

children.label: LATERAL
children.detail: Subquery can reference earlier FROM items; top-N per row.
